use: recovery commit only after runtime readiness
unifieddb.warning: Copy completion is not semantic recovery.

use: define update/recovery success as full semantic readiness
preserve unrelated local state during rollback
frank.warning: Process start and source checkout alone do not establish restored cognition/runtime semantics.

use: Safe-Effect geometry must span all mutated resource classes
clay.warning: Historical rollback boundary was narrower than the effect boundary.

use: represent one update episode as source/dependency/config/model/DB/runtime-version node set plus commit/abort/readiness edges

use: remember that old FRANK updater's rollback was source-only while effects crossed dependencies/config/runtime
treat recovery success as a multi-resource evidence claim, never a green banner
